footprints.description: 14-pin SOIC (ADI/Linear S14, 0.150 in), 3.9 x 8.65 mm body, 1.27 mm pitch
footprints.note: ADI/Linear S14 (LTC DWG 05-08-1610) recommended solder pad layout (R1; inches control), datasheets/opamp/adi/60112fc.pdf p.17: pads .030 +-.005 wide (0.762) x .045 +-.005 long (1.143), .050 BSC pitch (1.27), .160 +-.005 between the pad rows (4.064), .245 MIN overall -> span .160 + .045 = .205 in = 5.207 mm (same layout as SOIC-8-ADI-S8). Body E1 3.90 mid (.150-.157 in, 3.81-3.99) x D 8.65 mid (.337-.344 in, 8.560-8.738)

footprints.description: 8-pin SC70 (Maxim X8C-1 / X8SN-1), 1.25 x 2.0 mm body, 0.5 mm pitch
footprints.note: Maxim 8L SC70 outline 21-0460 rev A, JEDEC MO-203 (R2; land pattern 90-0348 only referenced, not drawn), datasheets/opamp/adi/max9613-max9615.pdf p.11 (same package in max9636-max9638.pdf p.11, outline only referenced): L 0.26-0.46 mid 0.36 -> pad length 0.36 + 0.8 = 1.16; b 0.15-0.27 mid 0.21 -> pad width 0.21 + 0.05 = 0.26; HE 1.80-2.40 nom 2.20 tip to tip -> span 2.20 + 1.0 - 1.16 = 2.04; e 0.50 BSC; body E 1.25 (1.15-1.35) x D 2.00 (1.80-2.20). Drawing's top view has pin 1 bottom left with the leads on the top and bottom; turned 90 deg CW so pin 1 is the top of the left column

footprints.description: 8-pin MSOP (ADI/Linear MS8 Rev F, JEDEC MO-187-AA), 3.0 x 3.0 mm body, 0.65 mm pitch
footprints.note: ADI/Linear MS8 (LTC DWG 05-08-1660 Rev F) recommended solder pad layout (R1), datasheets/opamp/adi/14901afd.pdf p.13 (same Rev F drawing in 16389fg.pdf p.14, 600345fd.pdf p.17, 6244fb.pdf p.24): pads 0.42 +-0.038 wide x 0.889 +-0.127 long, pitch 0.65 BSC, 5.23 MIN overall, 3.20-3.45 between the rows -> span 5.23 - 0.889 = 4.341. Body 3.00 x 3.00 (+-0.102). Not MSOP-8-ADI-MS8 (Rev G: 5.10 overall, span 4.211)

footprints.description: 8-lead SOT-23, ADI RJ-8 (MO-178-BA), 1.6 x 2.9 mm body, 0.65 mm pitch
footprints.note: ADI RJ-8 outline (R2, no land pattern printed), datasheets/opamp/adi/ad8502_8504.pdf p.14 (Figure 40): L 0.30-0.60 mid 0.45 -> pad length 0.45 + 0.8 = 1.25; b 0.22-0.38 mid 0.30 -> pad width 0.35 (b + 0.05, as TSOT-5-ADI-UJ); tip to tip 2.60-3.00 mid 2.80 -> span 2.80 + 1.0 - 1.25 = 2.55; e 0.65 BSC; body E1 1.50-1.70 mid 1.60 x D 2.80-3.00 mid 2.90. The Maxim SOT-23 8L K8 outline 21-0078 (max4464-max4474.pdf p.16: L 0.30-0.60, b 0.22-0.38, E 2.60-3.00, E1 1.50-1.75 nom 1.625, D 2.80-3.00, MO-178 BA) has the same leads. Not SOT23-8-DCN (TI pads 1.1 x 0.45, span 2.6) or TSOT-8-ADI-TS8 (LTC pads 1.22 x 0.52, span 2.62)

footprints.description: 8-pin SOIC (Renesas/Intersil M8.15, MS-012-AA), 3.9 x 4.9 mm body, 1.27 mm pitch
footprints.note: Renesas/Intersil M8.15 (Rev 4, 1/12) typical recommended land pattern (R1: pads 2.20 long x 0.60 wide, 1.27 pitch, 5.20 pad-centre span), datasheets/timer/renesas/icm7555-icm7556-datasheet.pdf p.10; body 3.9 mid (3.80-4.00) x 4.9 mid (4.80-5.00) from the M8.15 outline

footprints.description: 14-pin SO-14 (ST), 3.9 x 8.65 mm body, 1.27 mm pitch
footprints.note: ST SO-14 recommended footprint (R1), datasheets/opamp/st/en.cd00000533.pdf p.13 Figure 29 (same drawing in en.cd00003624.pdf p.15, en.cd00127596.pdf p.23, lm2902b.pdf p.14): pads 0.57 x 1.40, pitch 1.27, outer extent 6.70, gap 3.90 -> span 5.30; body E1 3.90 x D 8.65 from Table 4. footprints.note: ST TSSOP-14 recommended footprint (R1), datasheets/opamp/st/en.cd00000533.pdf p.15 Figure 31 (same drawing in en.dm00078536.pdf p.28, en.cd00144611.pdf p.25, lm2902b.pdf p.16): pads 1.20 x 0.40, pitch 0.65, outer extent 6.80, gap 4.40 -> span 5.60; body E1 4.40 x D 5.00 from Table 5. footprints.description: 6-pin SC70-6 / SOT323-6 (ST), 1.25 x 2.0 mm body, 0.65 mm pitch
footprints.note: ST SC70-6 (or SOT323-6) recommended footprint (R1), datasheets/opamp/st/en.cd00219052.pdf p.23 Figure 29: pads 1.05 x 0.40, pitch 0.65, outer extent 2.90, gap 0.80 -> span 1.85; body E1 1.25 x D 2.0 from the outline p.22. Not SC70-6 (TI: 0.9 x 0.4, span 2.2)

footprints.description: 8-pin MiniSO8 (ST, MO-187-AA), 3.0 x 3.0 mm body, 0.65 mm pitch
footprints.note: ST MiniSO8 recommended footprint (R1: 0.5 x8 pad width, 2.4 inner gap, 5.2 outer extent, 0.65 pitch -> pad length (5.2-2.4)/2 = 1.4, span 5.2-1.4 = 3.8), datasheets/opamp/st/tsb622.pdf p.23 Figure 44 (same drawing en.cd00063292.pdf p.13 Figure 22). Body E1 3.0 x D 3.0 (2.8-3.2 / 2.9-3.1 nominal 3.00) from the MiniSO8 mechanical data (en.cd00000464.pdf p.18). Not VSSOP-8-DGK (TI: 1.4 x 0.45 pads, span 4.4)

footprints.description: 8-pin PowerPAD SOIC (DDA), 3.9 x 4.9 mm body, 1.27 mm pitch, exposed pad 2.6 x 3.1 mm
footprints.note: TI DDA0008J example board layout 4221637/B 03/2016 (R1; 8X (1.55) x 8X (0.6), 6X (1.27) pitch, (5.4) pad-centre span, (2.6) x (3.1) solder-mask-opening thermal pad; metal 2.95 x 4.9 per note 9 and vias not drawn), datasheets/opamp/ti/opa445.pdf p.23; body 3.9 mid (3.8-4.0) x 4.9 mid (4.8-5.0) from outline p.22 (exposed pad 2.0-2.6 x 2.5-3.1; JEDEC MS-012 BA)

footprints.description: TO-263 (DDPAK-7), 7 leads + tab, TI KTW0007A drawing, 8.89 x 10.1 mm body
footprints.note: TI KTW0007A example board layout (R1), datasheets/opamp/ti/opa452.pdf p.21 (outline p.20): lead pads 3.45 x 0.94 at 1.27 pitch (7X .136 x .037 in), tab land 8.4 x 10.5 (.331 x .413 in); 6.35 from the lead pad centres to the package centre line (the exposed metal's left edge) and 3.85 from that line to the tab land's centre; turned as drawn (leads left, pin 1 top); origin = mould body centre: body 8.89 (8.39-9.39 mid) x 10.1 (9.78-10.41 mid), package centre line 2.78 from the body's left face (scaled from the outline), body half 4.445 -> package centre line at x -1.67, lead pads at x -8.02, tab land centre at x +2.18. The drawing numbers the tab 8 but the pinout has 7 pins, so the tab is the unnumbered pad (pin 0) as in TO-263-5-KTT
